newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES SEEN RISING AFTER DOW ADVANCE.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES SEEN RISING AFTER DOW ADVANCE.

text.p: Danish share prices traded higher in the early market on Thursday, bolstered by the overnight Dow advance, the strong dollar and a stabilisation of bond markets with rises foreseen after the past days of falls.
"The U.S. should give most European markets a shot in the arm. We could see the KFX index climbing by a half percentage point today as the market undertone is more positive," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.63 point to 185.39 at 0745 GMT, after closing 0.41 point lower on Wednesday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
